cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I cupped my hands round my mouth like you. Dragon greetings. He can stay for tea; do wipe those biscuit crumbs off my carpet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was calling him back. His three heads breathe fire; should I take him outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Called in, yes. He's fine. Three mouths? I need three napkins immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen.
